Two men, one a Latino taxi driver and the other a Latino physics teacher, were both house hunting with their families. The Latino taxi driver's family is having a much harder time than the other family because they are using Section 8 vouchers to help pay for their housing instead of just going through the bank. Which family receives government benefits?
A. The Latino physics teacher's family
B. The Latino taxi driver's family
C. Not answerable
